name: Traxxas X-Maxx 8S
description: Replica of the Traxxas X-Maxx 8S from published dimensions, mass, tire size, motor Kv and claimed top speed (assets/vehicles/x-maxx/design.json); suspension, inertia, tire, ESC current and drivetrain values are labelled estimates, not measured vehicle data. Shape only, no logos or graphics.

geometry_source.rights_status: Replica of the Traxxas X-Maxx 8S (77086-4) made with the permission the project owner stated on 2026-11-17 (docs/DECISIONS.md). Shape and proportions only: no Traxxas logos, decals or graphics are included.
